# Company Cards at Orbit Labs

This fictional policy belongs to Orbit Labs, the second demo tenant.

## Limits

An Orbit Labs company card has a single-transaction limit of 800 EUR and a monthly limit of 3,000 EUR.

## Receipts

Receipts are photographed in the Orbit Labs expense app within 14 days of the purchase.

## Lost cards

Lost cards are reported to the office manager, who blocks the card and orders a new one.
